Maria Chen: Heads-up: starting integration tests for FlashAttention v2/v3 selector today. Looking for quick sanity checks on KV behavior + batching. I'll post perf diffs shortly.

Nora Patel: Please include p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, kv_hit_rate, and a small trace sample if possible. Quick numbers are fine.

Maria Chen: Quick run from staging (seq=512 / seq=2048):
```
model: attn-test
config: selector=auto, batching=adaptive_default
--- seq=512 ---
v2: p50=12.4ms p95=28.1ms tps=1780 tok/s mem=8.6GB kv_hit_rate=0.94
v3: p50=11.8ms p95=25.0ms tps=1860 tok/s mem=9.1GB kv_hit_rate=0.92
--- seq=2048 ---
v2: p50=48.2ms p95=112.4ms tps=420 tok/s mem=14.3GB kv_hit_rate=0.90
v3: p50=40.5ms p95=88.6ms tps=520 tok/s mem=17.9GB kv_hit_rate=0.79
```

Arjun Rao: Hmm big kv_hit_rate drop at 2048 for v3. Latency improves but caching seems to miss more. Could be kernel reordering or page alignment differences.

Maria Chen: Agreed. v3 switches to a fused tiled attention path that appears to change how we store/retrieve paged KV segments. Repro snippet for selector override:
```json
{"attn.selector": "force_v3", "kv.cache.page_size": 64, "kv.eviction": "lru"}
```
Switching page_size -> 128 raises kv_hit_rate back to ~0.86 in the quick test.

Lee Wong: Ops note: if prefix caching degrades we should gate the selector behind a feature flag `attn.selector_v3_compat` and fallback to v2 when `kv_hit_rate < 0.85`. Also emit `attn.selector.fallback_count` metric. Ops/UI can flip the flag per-pool.

Sam Ortiz: +1. Suggested rollout plan: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with 6h observation windows. Rollback criteria: p95 increase >5% or kv_hit_rate drop >3% relative to baseline. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Devin Blake: Any signal on output quality/regression (tokens/content)? Need to track that too for customer-facing flows.

Maria Chen: No regressions on our held-out eval set so far (n=1k prompts). Will run additional evals weighted toward long-context flows.

Nora Patel: Also want microbench for batching heuristics. v3 seems to benefit from larger micro-batches; latency for micro-batch sizes <8 regresses. Please capture batch size distribution in telemetry.

Maria Chen: Will do. Plan to push a canary with `batching_policy: adaptive_v3`, `kv_eviction=LRU-128`, and a pinned small traffic pool. I'll publish results to the perf doc.

bench-bot: benchbot: run 2076543210-1 finished: delta p95 = -3.1% (improved), kv_hit_rate = -1.2% (within threshold). CSV: https://ci.internal/bench/2076543210-1.csv

Arjun Rao: Can we add a unit/integration test that asserts KV API invariants across kernel switches? I can add a pytest that toggles selector and validates identical KV read/write semantics + cache headers.

Maria Chen: Perfect — action items:
- Maria: push flag + staged canary with adjusted page_size and adaptive_v3 batching
- Lee: add `attn.selector_v3_compat` flag, `attn.selector.fallback_count` metric, and emergency rollback route
- Arjun: KV invariants tests across kernel switch paths
- Nora: run microbench matrix (batch sizes, seq len 256/512/1024/2048) and produce CSV
- Sam: prepare rollout playbook for staging->prod windows and automated alerting on p95/kv_hit_rate

I'll circle back with post-canary notes in this thread. Thanks!
